### Animals & Breeding

items.text: Old scientists now turn instantly instead of steering.
Cargo scientists now move correctly.
Scientist2 on Oilrig crouchwalks upstairs at the correct angle.
Fixed catapult loaded ammo pooling bug.
Horse client pooling fixes improve stability.
Siege weapons now reset properly after use.
Container UI reset fixes ensure battering ram visuals display correctly.
Salvaged hammer 3rd‑person model now aligns with the player's hand.
Foundations with staircases now correctly pass line‑of‑sight checks for soft‑side melee damage.
Wind turbine sound stops when the turbine is not spinning.
Stats widget sizing corrected.
Static chairs on the gas station roof are now mountable.
Darts leaderboard UI improvements: removed zoom control, added streamer‑mod compatibility, and fixed leaderboard after server restart.
Tutorial modal size fixed and unused background asset removed.
Connection modal description cleaned up.
Monument toggle switches error fixed.
Honey bandage now correctly triggers its effects.
Added full dog asset pack including models, materials, animations, entity prefabs and harnesses.
Improved vehicle pooling logic to handle child destruction correctly and reduce related errors.
Adjusted third‑person flamethrower flame offset for proper visual alignment.
Fixed fuel generator auxiliary inputs from draining batteries via downstream demand.
Corrected elevator billing to draw batteries from the proper slot.
Applied post‑merge fixes to powergrid and powerline power handling.
Restored HBHF sensor’s IncludeOthers flag after regression.
Resolved several color‑picker and painting UI issues: color cookie leakage between menus, pumpkin carving double projection, and hex‑code paste rejection.
Localized and fixed the tutorial modal menu.
Fixed leaderboard and streamer‑mode display errors for scores and score cards.
Fixed pink rendering bug in multi‑client play mode.
Added safeguard to prevent crashes on game boot caused by hide‑services changes.
Corrected binocular glare logic that was inverted, restoring proper glare behavior.
Updated FP.Nexus to prefer AssignedZoneKey over ConnectZoneKey for player clients, improving zone assignment reliability.
Added new livestock species assets for cows and sheep, supporting separate male and female prefabs.
Fixed animals moving while sleeping.
Added sleeping animation for sheep.
Livestock now sit while pregnant; vitals are frozen to prevent starvation.
Introduced a social stat for livestock based on nearby animal count, shown on the crosshair.
Breeding now requires all livestock stats to be above 50%.
Refactored livestock timers into a PersistentTimer class, enabling persistent behaviors such as dung dropping, aging, and birthing; livestock now drop horse dung.
Fixed desks blocker rendering issue and reduced health on larger blockers.
Disabled bonus resource gathering on monument blockers and standardized melee kill times and resource outputs across all blockers.
Added monument blockers to monuments.
Cleared cached vehicle owner when a seat is pooled to fix pooling bugs.
Added Apple.tree prefab and Apple loot; apples spawn on oak_d but do not appear when harvesting.
Hide services menu no longer appears in the iteration speed section of the Rust editor.
Resolved flag collision issues by reassigning to free flags, including fixing the RidableHorse flag.

2026-08-18.summary:
### NPC & AI  
- Fixed scientists not spawning in Underwater Labs, Cargo Ships, and Military Base.  
- Fixed cargo scientists being immobile and Scientist 2 crouch‑walking oddly on the Oilrig.  
- Fixed old scientists steering incorrectly; they now turn instantly.  
- Fixed NPCs getting stuck when a navmesh tile rebuilds while they are inside or crossing it, and ensured AI spawned before an independent navmesh is built can locate it.  

### World & Monuments  
- Fixed static chairs on the gas‑station roof now mountable.  
- Fixed monument blocker rendering (desks), balanced their health and resource rates, and added blockers to all monuments.  
- Fixed wind‑turbine sound looping when the turbine isn’t spinning.  
- Fixed Jungle Ziggurat water‑treatment tank to use a single mesh collider for better performance.  

### Vehicles & Weapons  
- Fixed catapult loaded‑ammo pooling bug and horse client pooling issues; cached vehicle owners are cleared when seats are pooled.  
- Fixed siege weapons resetting properly after use.  
- Reset helicopter rotor speed and animators on init to prevent odd behavior.  
- Fixed flamethrower third‑person flame offset and salvaged hammer model offset.  

### UI & Quality of Life  
- Fixed Darts leaderboard UI: removed zoom control, added streamer‑mode compatibility, and ensured persistence after server restarts.  
- Fixed colour picker now accepts pasted hex‑code inputs.  
- Fixed binocular glare bug caused by an inverted check.  

### Animals & Livestock  
- Added new livestock species (cows and sheep) with male/female prefabs and proper spawning.  
- Fixed livestock animals moving while sleeping; they now sit while pregnant and drop dung correctly.

items.text: All livestock animals now have correct genders and breeding state machine, fixing the issue where every animal was female.
Bull prefab added, introducing bulls as a new breedable livestock animal.
Medical honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.
Water bucket UI fixed so players can transfer water into a held bucket.
Battery items now properly receive additional data via client RPC.
Nexus connect modal UI bugs fixed: map button now enables, map no longer squishes, and overall modal stability improved.
Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged with "nexuszone", hidden from the server list by default, and expose Nexus info in A2S rules.
MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent changes.
UI rows alignment corrected, removing the left offset on non-keyframable rows.
Vehicle pooling now detaches runtime‑parented children before pooling, preventing NRE spamming.
Underwater Labs windows refraction texture fixed, improving visibility inside labs.

2026-08-17.summary:
### Animals & Breeding
- All livestock animals now have correct genders and breeding state machine, fixing the issue where every animal was female.
- Bull prefab added, introducing bulls as a new breedable livestock animal.

### Items & Equipment
- Medical honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.
- Water bucket UI fixed so players can transfer water into a held bucket.
- Battery items now properly receive additional data via client RPC.

### UI & Server Connectivity
- Nexus connect modal UI bugs fixed: map button now enables, map no longer squishes, and overall modal stability improved.
- Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged with "nexuszone", hidden from the server list by default, and expose Nexus info in A2S rules.
- MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent changes.
- UI rows alignment corrected, removing the left offset on non-keyframable rows.

### Vehicles
- Vehicle pooling now detaches runtime‑parented children before pooling, preventing NRE spamming.

### Gameplay & World
- Underwater Labs windows refraction texture fixed, improving visibility inside labs.
